notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Dockside Extortionist by sacrificing it.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Koll, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
